decisive_items: Liver MRI demonstrated an occupying lesion in the right lobe with mild intrahepatic bile duct dilatation, raising the possibility of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
a heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa in the right liver lobe
response.rationale: MRI explicitly suggests intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with bile duct dilatation and elevated CA19-9, while cholecystitis is a secondary finding; gallbladder cancer lacks direct supportive imaging features.

rejected.why: Mass near gallbladder fossa is nonspecific; MRI favors intrahepatic origin, not gallbladder primary.
